original.statement: ReferenceGrants RBAC permission is added to the Gateway API Traefik controller in version 3.0.0.

corrected.statement: The RBAC for Traefik's Gateway API controller now includes a permission on ReferenceGrants (referencegrants).

decision.reason: [ev-b93f05e6d823] says ReferenceGrants were added to the Gateway API Traefik controller RBAC, which supports an "added" rbac-permission with the resource name referencegrants. "Gateway API Traefik controller" describes Traefik's own controller and does not name a separate component, so the made-up component "gateway-api-controller" should be dropped. The text never states the API group, so group is also left out. Confidence is low because the entry sits under the changelog's Documentation section, so it may only record an update to the documented RBAC manifest, and the render validators were inconclusive.
